newsitem.title: USA: BFX settles Steel Partners, Ryback suit.
newsitem.headline: BFX settles Steel Partners, Ryback suit.

text.p: BFX Hospitality Group Inc said Tuesday it had settled its litigation against Steel Partners II LP and Ryback Management Corp.
Under the settlement, BFX said it has bought Ryback's BFX stake for $2.24 million and Steel Partners's BFX stake for $1.64 million.
The 1.63 million shares of BFX common owned by Steel and Ryback were acquired for a total of $3.88 million, or $2.38 per share, it said.

BFX said the defendants had agreed that for a period of 10 years, none of them or their affiliates or associates will, among other things, purchase BFX securities, solicit proxies with respect to BFX voting securities, or form or participate in any group with respect to BFX securities.
The repurchased shares will be held by BFX as treasury shares, reducing the total number of outstanding shares of BFX common to 6.03 million from 7.66 million, BFX said.

BFX (formerly Buffton Corp) had alleged that Steel, Ryback and others had been operating as a "group" under section 13(d) of the Securities Exchange Act in purchasing its stock. The defendants had denied all allegations of wrongful or unlawful conduct.
